comment: Track H (Sep 27, 2026) — casewhyhub.com becomes the partner hub for every CaseWhy line. `lines[]` are the two (soon three) product lines, each with its own home page under /{line}. `pages[]` are audience pages nested under a line's path. `companyPages[]` are the three line-spanning pages (press/resources/brand) that live at the top level. `redirects[]` are the permanent 301s from the pre-Track-H flat USCIS paths to their new /uscis/ twins, applied via vercel.json (generated by scripts/generate-vercel-json.mjs from this same array so the two never drift). Regenerate everything with `node scripts/generate.mjs`.
